mapper.select: select client_id, app_id, app_secret, app_name, status from spas_open_client where app_id = #{appId} limit 1
select parent_id, parent_name, mobile, status, create_time from spas_parent where mobile = #{mobile} limit 1

select s.student_id, s.student_no, s.student_name, s.dept_id, s.gender, s.status from spas_parent_student ps inner join spas_student s on s.student_id = ps.student_id where ps.parent_id = #{parentId} and ps.bind_status = '0' and s.del_flag = '0' order by s.student_id

select count(*) from spas_parent_student ps inner join spas_student s on s.student_id = ps.student_id where ps.parent_id = #{parentId} and ps.student_id = #{studentId} and ps.bind_status = '0' and s.del_flag = '0'
select client_id, app_id, app_secret, app_name, status, create_time from spas_open_client where client_id = #{clientId}
mapper.insert: insert into spas_open_client(app_id, app_secret, app_name, status, create_time) values(#{appId}, #{appSecret}, #{appName}, coalesce(#{status}, '0'), now())
mapper.delete: delete from spas_open_client where client_id in #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into spas_parent(parent_name, mobile, status, create_time) values(#{parentName}, #{mobile}, coalesce(#{status}, '0'), now())
mapper.delete: delete from spas_parent where parent_id in #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into spas_parent_student(parent_id, student_id, bind_status, create_time) values(#{parentId}, #{studentId}, '0', now()) on conflict (parent_id, student_id) do update set bind_status = '0'
mapper.delete: delete from spas_parent_student where parent_id = #{parentId} and student_id = #{studentId}
mapper.select: select s.student_id, s.student_no, s.student_name, s.dept_id, s.gender, s.status from spas_parent_student ps inner join spas_student s on s.student_id = ps.student_id where ps.parent_id = #{parentId} and ps.bind_status = '0' and s.del_flag = '0' order by s.student_no asc
